task_description: Build a comprehensive quantitative research pipeline that generates 100+ market hypotheses, statistically tests each one, rejects weak hypotheses, validates strong hypotheses with walk-forward and out-of-sample testing, designs entry/exit/position-sizing rules for validated edges, and performs final robustness testing with realistic transaction costs. Uses NASDAQ data from yfinance and honestly acknowledges data limitations (OHLCV only, no true order flow).
